newsitem.title: USA: World Airways sees Q3 at $0.23-0.25 share.
newsitem.headline: World Airways sees Q3 at $0.23-0.25 share.

text.p: World Airways Inc said it expects earnings from continuing operations and net earnings for the the third quarter to be about $2.8-3.0 million, or about $0.23-0.25 per share, exceeding analysts' estimates.
World Airways on Monday said analysts' expectations have ranged between $0.00 and $0.20 per share.

"Our core business -- wet leasing to air carriers that are outsourcing to meet demand or reduce costs -- continues to perform well, as measured by market demand, the strength of our backlog, and cash generation from operations," said World's President and CEO, Charles W. Pollard in a statement.

World Airways provides worldwide passenger and cargo air transportation under contracts with major international airlines, the U.S. Air Force and international tour operators. The carrier, which operates a fleet of MD-11 and DC10-30 aircraft, is owned 59% by WorldCorp, 17% by MHS Berhad, a Malaysian strategic investor, and 24% by public investors. --New York News Desk (212) 859-1610
